parts.html: The K-04 kitchen model combines a refined grey color palette, contemporary styling, and the natural character of quartzite to create a sophisticated kitchen interior.
Its L-shaped configuration provides an efficient arrangement of cooking, preparation, and storage areas, making the model suitable for modern apartments and private residences.
The coordinated grey finish creates a calm architectural appearance, allowing the kitchen to complement natural wood, stone textures, light walls, and contemporary interior materials.
A quartzite countertop introduces the distinctive appearance of natural stone, while painted upper and lower cabinet fronts maintain a cohesive, understated furniture composition.
With a total linear length of 5.5 meters, the K-04 model offers practical cabinet storage and integrated appliance placement without requiring a separate kitchen island.
The cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard, providing a stable foundation for the kitchen furniture.
A pull-out cargo system helps organize kitchen essentials and makes efficient use of cabinet space.
For everyday convenience, the model features Hettich soft-close hinges and AvanTech YOU Hettich drawer systems, supporting smooth cabinet operation and comfortable access to stored items.
Furniture handles are included in the standard configuration.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for residential properties in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-04 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, appliance requirements, storage preferences, and architectural features.
Our services include customized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
Order your K-04 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and create a contemporary interior combining natural stone, refined cabinetry, and practical everyday functionality.
